# Clavis 3.1

## ✨ New

- **Encrypt right from File Explorer.** Right-click a file → **Clavis → Encrypt**. Right-click an encrypted file → **Decrypt** or **Verify**. Right-click a folder for all of these plus **Add to Watch Folder**. On Windows 11, choose **Show more options** first.
- **Select several files at once** and they're handled together, with a single confirmation.
- **Start from the menu, even when Clavis is closed** — it opens, asks for your password, then carries on.
- **One Clavis window.** Opening Clavis again brings your existing window to the front instead of asking for your password twice.
- You can turn the right-click menu off in **Settings → Explorer**.

Folder actions and watch folders are part of Clavis Pro; encrypting, decrypting and verifying individual files is free.

## Install / upgrade

- **Already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now). The right-click menu appears after Clavis next starts.
- **New install:** download **Clavis-Setup.exe** from the website and run it.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
